coverage.scope: United States ZIP codes and included territory identifiers

representation.aliases: Not represented; CityID uses the normalized primary city plus state identity.
representation.acceptablePlaceNames: Not represented by this schema; only the provider's primary city field is searchable.
representation.territories: Included when present in state_id and treated like states.
representation.poBoxes: Not classified; records may include them but no ZIP-type field is bundled.
representation.militaryZIPs: Not classified and may be absent depending on provider coverage.
representation.multiPlaceZIPs: One primary city is stored per ZIP; alternate places require a future aliases collection.

knownLimitations: No ZIP type, delivery class, alias, or alternate-place metadata.
Coordinates and administrative names reflect the source snapshot and require periodic replacement to update.
